en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Isma`il b. Ibrahim al-Hilwani informed me. He said: Ahmad b. Mansur Bazraj narrated to us. He said: Hadiya b. `Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abd al-Hamid b. Ja`far narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ziyad al-Yamami narrated to us from `Ikrama b. `Ammar from Ishaq b. `Abdullah b. Abi Talha from Anas b. Malik. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: We, the Children of `Abd al-Muttalib, are the masters of the people of Paradise: The Messenger of Allah, Hamza the Master of Martyrs, Ja`far the one of two wings, `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and the Mahdi.
